founders.background_notes: Bio says ex researcher at those institutions; 15+ papers per launch post.

technical_complexity.rationale: Low latency teleoperation software and staffed operations center; latency figures are company claims.

defensibility.rationale: Operator network and data could accumulate, but teleoperation is easy to replicate.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Scale AI was reported considering teleoperation; no action against Aktoria is public.

market_need_then: Robot data demand rose in 2026 with several teleoperation data startups raising money.

branding.brand_signature: Tagline: Human as API for Robots

brand_strength.rationale: Memorable tagline but no press or community evidence beyond directory pages.

outcome_analysis: Aktoria is a two person Summer 2026 company selling remote operators and teleoperation data. No outcome yet: the company is Active and a 2026 batch member; outcome searches found no acquisition, shutdown or layoff news. It faces better funded data startups, and its cost claims are unverified.
notes: Funding unverified: Caplight lists $500K accelerator round dated 2026-06 and Dealroom a $125k seed; aggregators only, so no round recorded. The company site shows an Accel logo, but no press confirms an Accel investment, so it is not recorded. Location differs between Dealroom (New Delhi) and YC (San Francisco).
